title: The actual quotient tower after exact section transport
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and X a scheme. Use the actual integral module category [sk-def-pe-derived-completion] and the exact transport F and its small ring O [def-sfb-internal-completion-section-transport]. Define modules as the composite ordinary scalar restrictions and small-site section equivalence underlying F, and complex(P) by applying it termwise. The canonical exact-functor composition and localization isomorphisms give complexIso(P): F(Q(P)) ≅ Q(complex(P)). Define quotients(P) as the actual positive quotient complexes with their actual quotient transitions, transported termwise by modules. The actual tensor units define a natural transformation quotientUnits(P) from the constant tower complex(P) to quotients(P). Transpose quotients(P), using the existing complex/functor equivalence, to quotientComplex(P). The compatible family quotientUnits(P) gives quotientLimitUnit(P): complex(P) → lim quotientComplex(P). All data are explicit and no witness of an unproved existence theorem is selected.
